messages:
aj: heads up — running into an authz weirdness with org-scoped API keys. when the same key is used by two different projects we sometimes route to the org default project for quota/telemetry instead of the child project :confused:

mara: hmm, repro? steps + minimal request?

aj: repro steps below. basically: one key created at org level, project header set to X-Project: proj-a in client. sometimes logs show attribution to proj-a, sometimes to org-default. looks correlated with cached routing entries after a scale-up.

aj: example request:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer org_key_abc123
X-Project: proj-a
Content-Type: application/json
{ "prompt": "hi" }
```

lucas: can you paste the raw routing log lines? curious if we fall back because the project-specific route was evicted from the routing table.

aj: pasted two snippets from frontend logs: 
[2026-06-12T10:02:11Z] route_lookup: key=org_key_abc123 -> project=proj-a (cache hit)
[2026-06-12T10:05:33Z] route_lookup: key=org_key_abc123 -> project=org-default (fallback, no affinity)

mara: that looks like affinity (sticky routing) got reset. we intentionally have a short TTL for key->project affinity to avoid stale binds, but that means intermittent fallback attribution.

dina: UX question: should org-scoped keys be allowed to claim a project via client header? or must they always be org-level (no project attribution) unless bound in console?

sam: +1 on explicit binding. if org keys silently adopt project attribution based on header we get weird billing surprises. console binding makes behavior predictable.

lucas: technically we support three modes: 
- org-only: key never attributes to a project
- header-affinity: if X-Project present we create ephemeral affinity entry 
- pinned-binding: admin pins key to a project in console
we default to header-affinity today.

mara: right. header-affinity reduces friction for devs with cross-project scripts but it's surprising for accounting. options: increase affinity TTL, make header-affinity opt-in, or change default to org-only and add console prompt during key creation.

aj: migration concern: many existing customers will have org keys relying on header-affinity. switching default to org-only would break attribution for them. we need a rollout plan with telemetry to detect impacted customers.

dina: telemetry piece: we need a signal for "org_key used with X-Project where project != org-default" and then measure token usage and billing delta. add cohort tagging so we can roll change per-org.

infra-bot: deployed canary config: authz/affinity-ttl increased from 30s -> 5m in canary region us-west-2 at 2026-06-13T02:00Z.

sam: proposal: default -> org-only, but during key creation console shows a checkbox: "Allow project binding from client header (ephemeral)" (off by default). Provide migration tool to convert org keys with active header usage to pinned binding with confirmation.

mara: also need a console telemetry page listing org keys with cross-project hits and an action to convert to pin or disable. that helps support and billing ops.

lucas: implementation notes: router currently caches key->target project in LRU with per-entry TTL. pinning can be represented as a permanent cache entry and also create an immutable claim in authz DB. fallback behavior: only fall back to org-default when no cache entry and binding policy == org-only.

aj: question about rate limit attribution: if we change defaults, ensure quota blowups are handled gracefully. e.g., if a key loses project affinity and now counts against org-default quota, we should emit a distinct metric and not reject until we notify.

dina: agreed. rollout plan:
1) add telemetry for cross-project usage (2 weeks)
2) UI: console list + binding action (3 weeks)
3) change default to org-only but behind feature flag, allow per-org opt-in to header-affinity (canary) (2 weeks)
4) 4-week monitored ramp and migration assistance

sam: can we also offer an ephemeral exchange endpoint: POST /v1/exchange to mint a project-scoped short-lived token from an org key if admin enabled? that keeps UX but makes scope explicit.

mara: love that. exchange endpoint with explicit audit logs and TTL = 15m. will help audit and telemetry.

aj: ok next actions: aj will open PR to add telemetry counters and log labels; lucas will spec DB binding changes; dina will sketch console UX; sam will prototype exchange endpoint. we'll sync in 48h. :thumbsup:

mara: thanks — add incident tag if we see billing anomalies during canary, we should pause.

aj: noted. closing for now, will post links to PRs here when ready.
